messages:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-52088 generated for Ember Analytics — total $15,842.15. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-52088

olivia (Finance): Ember says the promotional credit from our Q4 pricing experiment didn't apply; they expected the 20% promo to reduce the invoice.

kai (Sales): We enrolled Ember in the promo (promo-code: Q4-PILOT-20) on 2024-11-01, but they also migrated plans 11/10 -> reserved plan same day. Could be an overlapping rule.

rahul (Pricing): The experiment logic has precedence: explicit plan discount should stack with promo unless exclude flag set. I need the invoice line items to confirm.

zoe (Billing): Pulled lines: usage $13,230.00, reserved discount applied -$1,750.00, no promo line present. System shows promo blocked by "plan_migration" event on 2024-11-10 02:03 UTC.

nadia (Customer Success): Customer emailed that sales told them promo would be applied for the first two billing cycles post-migration. They have the signed note in the CS ticket.

olivia (Finance): If Sales committed promo, we need to honor it. Estimate: 20% promo on post-discount invoice -> ~ $2,070. Suggested credit $2,070 and invoice reissue.

cory (Finance Lead): Approve one-time promo credit of $2,070 contingent on Sales confirmation. Add GL: 4107; journal: CRD-EMBER-20241112. Also mark in CRM that this is a contracted concession.

kai (Sales): Confirmed — I signed off on the pilot promise in thread ID 5421. Will add a short note to CRM and cc legal.

zoe (Billing): Creating credit memo CM-7924 for $2,070.00 and reissuing INV-52088 -> INV-52088-R. Tagging reason: "promo honor post-plan-migration (sales concession)".

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-7924 created for INV-52088-R amount $2,070.00 (status: pending).

olivia (Finance): Please ensure we update pricing engine to not auto-block promo for this customer. Rahul, can you add an exception rule?

rahul (Pricing): Will add exception: customers with sales concession flag `promo_granted=true` bypass migration block. Rolling patch to staging now.

cory (Finance Lead): Good. Keep documentation (CS ticket + CRM) linked to the CM. Also, avoid opening policy precedent — flag as "sales-approved one-time".

nadia (Customer Success): I'll notify Ember once CM posts and confirm they see the credit on next invoice.

zoe (Billing): Journal posted: `CRD-EMBER-20241112 | GL 4107 | Amount 2070.00 | Note: honor Q4 pilot promo`.
